cohort: The study included 171 healthy pregnant women with spontaneous onset of labor (117 had vaginal delivery and 54 underwent urgent C-section).
finding: Low maternal aldosterone concentrations showed the strongest association with urgent C-section, suggesting a protective role for aldosterone in successful vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Women who underwent urgent C-section had significantly lower serum concentrations of SHBG, corticosterone, cortisol, aldosterone, progesterone, 17-hydroxyprogesterone, DHEA, DHEAS, and free testosterone compared to the vaginal delivery group.
